inputs.description: previous white ChatGPT-oriented draft, used to strengthen Codex recognition
Codex cloud app icon, including a small >_ glyph recreated in silver

prompt: Use case: compositing / logo-brand. Redesign the personal ChatGPT × Codex plugin emblem. Input 1 is the current white interwoven mark, an edit target that failed because it only looked like ChatGPT. Input 2 is the ChatGPT knot reference. Input 3 is the actual Codex cloud app icon, the identity reference. Make the Codex connection visually EXPLICIT: the overall outer shape must be the distinct broad, softly scalloped Codex cloud from input 3, not another six-petal ChatGPT rosette. Integrate a recognizable ChatGPT interwoven ribbon knot into the left/upper interior of that cloud, in a clean unified composition. Add a SMALL but clearly formed exact Codex prompt glyph >_ in the lower-right interior, approximately one quarter of the total symbol width. The glyph is LIGHT SILVER GREY, never black, and has no surrounding terminal window, dark square, badge or frame. It should be clear at normal app-icon size. The cloud and knot are predominantly pearl WHITE; use restrained light/mid neutral silver contours and negative-space cuts for structure and legibility. No black or charcoal anywhere; no dark fills. Premium art direction: optically balanced, calm sculptural geometry, clean substantial strokes, generous deliberate negative space, very subtle neutral porcelain depth rather than glossy 3D, no busy detail. The cloud silhouette must remain distinct from the inner knot. Genuine transparent background; a single centered finished 1:1 icon with even padding, occupying about 85 percent of the square. No blue, purple or saturated colors. No text wordmark, document, clipboard, checklist, app tile, large terminal screen, deep shadow, metallic chrome, glow, watermark or fake checkerboard. The only visible characters are the small silver >_ Codex glyph. Prioritize a visibly recognizable Codex cloud PLUS the ChatGPT knot rather than a tiny modification to the ChatGPT knot.
postprocessing: PNG size export only; generated alpha retained
brand_notice: Non-official personal derivative. Brand rights remain with their owners; original reference assets are not redistributed.
approved_direction: White Codex cloud, ChatGPT knot, small silver >_ prompt glyph; no black fill or terminal window
